strips.title: A calm Black Friday — in real life

panels.head: Now — the list
panels.text: Write down the eleven prices. A number you set in October beats a banner you see in November.

panels.head: Nov 19 on — the check
panels.text: Open the brand store and Walmart beside the deal. Match the model number, then compare with your number.

panels.head: The trap
panels.text: "Was $399" on something that has sold for $250 all year is not a saving. Walk away.

panels.head: Nov 27 on — the buy
panels.text: At or under the number: buy, and keep the receipt for the holiday return window.
